 Video: Pellegrino’s tribute to Batistuta after goal vs. Juventus 
 By Lorenzo Bettoni 
 Nov 8, 2026 20:36 
 FLORENCE, ITALY - NOVEMBER 08: Mateo Pellegrino of ACF Fiorentina celebrates after scoring a goal during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and Juventus at Stadio Artemio Franchi on November 8, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) 
 Fiorentina striker Mateo Pellegrino imitated legendary Gabriel Omar Batistuta after scoring the opening goal in a home match against Juventus.
 Pellegrino opened the account just four minutes in, beating Juventus goalkeeper Guglielmo Vicario with a towering header from a corner-kick routine.
 FLORENCE, ITALY – NOVEMBER 08: Mateo Pellegrino of ACF Fiorentina celebrates after scoring a goal during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and Juventus at Stadio Artemio Franchi on November 8, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) FLORENCE, ITALY – NOVEMBER 08: Mateo Pellegrino of ACF Fiorentina celebrates after scoring a goal during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and Juventus at Stadio Artemio Franchi on November 8, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images) His post-goal gesture was familiar to Tuscan fans: he recreated Batistuta’s iconic ‘machine gun’ celebration as his teammates embraced him.
 Juventus equalised before the break when Nick Woltemade netted his first Serie A goal in the 32nd minute.
 Football Italia is among the accredited media at the Franchi this evening.
